crossRefs.note: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those…
For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and…
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will…
By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

translations.web: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
translations.bsb: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
translations.kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
